			column ViewType

				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: ViewType

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition Fact_VolumeSpend = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    // --- local helpers -----------------------------------------------------
						
						    // UPS prefixes ID-like columns with an apostrophe to stop Excel reformatting
						    // them. Left in place, "'ABC123" and "ABC123" are different keys and the
						    // account relationship silently half-fails.
						    Clean = (v) as text =>
						        let
						            t = if v = null then "" else Text.Trim(Text.From(v))
						        in
						            Text.Trim(if Text.StartsWith(t, "'") then Text.RemoveRange(t, 0, 1) else t),
						
						    Num = (v) as number => if v = null then 0 else (try Number.From(v) otherwise 0),
						
						    // Drop report artefacts only - Grand Total lines and rows with no account.
						    // Deliberately NOT keyed on the sub-parent: UPS masks it with "@@" on some
						    // accounts, and those rows carry a real account number and real shipment
						    // volume. Filtering on "@@" - the obvious move - silently deletes genuine
						    // international activity.
						    KeepRow = (sub, acct) as logical =>
						        let
						            s = Text.Lower(Clean(sub)),
						            a = Text.Lower(Clean(acct))
						        in
						            not (s = "grand total" or s = "total" or a = "grand total" or a = "total")
						            and not (a = "" and s = ""),
						
						    SubNameOf = (numv, namev) as text =>
						        if Clean(numv) = "@@" or Clean(namev) = "@@"
						        then "Unassigned Sub-Parent"
						        else Clean(namev),
						
						    MaskedOf = (numv, namev) as text =>
						        if Clean(numv) = "@@" or Clean(namev) = "@@" then "Yes" else "No",
						
						    FirstSheet = (fileName as text) as table =>
						        Table.SelectRows(
						            Excel.Workbook(File.Contents(p_Folder & "\" & fileName), null, true),
						            each [Kind] = "Sheet"){0}[Data],
						
						    // --- Schema A: January / February layout -------------------------------
						    // Column offsets, verified against the real extracts:
						    //   Column2  Sub Number        Column3  Sub Name
						    //   Column4  Account Number    Column5  Account Name
						    //   Column6  City              Column7  State
						    //   Column8  Product           Column9  WE/Mo/Qtr (period)
						    //   Column10 Volume (TY)       Column19 Gross Spend (TY)
						    //   Column22 Net Spend (TY)    Column25 Incentive (TY)
						    //   Column31 Billed Weight Lbs (TY)
						    ReadSchemaA = (fileName as text, monthNo as number) as table =>
						        let
						            Rows = Table.Skip(FirstSheet(fileName), 7),
						            Pick = Table.SelectColumns(Rows, {
						                "Column2", "Column3", "Column4", "Column5", "Column6", "Column7",
						                "Column8", "Column9", "Column10", "Column19", "Column22",
						                "Column25", "Column31"}),
						            Named = Table.RenameColumns(Pick, {
						                {"Column2", "SubNumberRaw"}, {"Column3", "SubNameRaw"},
						                {"Column4", "AccountNumberRaw"}, {"Column5", "AccountNameRaw"},
						                {"Column6", "CityRaw"}, {"Column7", "StateRaw"},
						                {"Column8", "ProductRaw"}, {"Column9", "PeriodRaw"},
						                {"Column10", "VolumeRaw"}, {"Column19", "GrossRaw"},
						                {"Column22", "NetRaw"}, {"Column25", "IncentiveRaw"},
						                {"Column31", "WeightRaw"}}),
						            // The period column is authoritative here. A YTD file holds several
						            // months, so this filter is what keeps January out of the February load.
						            Kept = Table.SelectRows(Named, each
						                KeepRow([SubNumberRaw], [AccountNumberRaw])
						                and Clean([ProductRaw]) <> ""
						                and Num([PeriodRaw]) = monthNo),
						            Shaped = Table.AddColumn(Kept, "Rec", each [
						                MonthNumber       = monthNo,
						                SubNumber         = Clean([SubNumberRaw]),
						                SubName           = SubNameOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                IsMaskedSubParent = MaskedOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                AccountNumber     = Clean([AccountNumberRaw]),
						                AccountName       = Clean([AccountNameRaw]),
						                City              = Clean([CityRaw]),
						                State             = Clean([StateRaw]),
						                ZIP               = "",
						                RawProduct        = Clean([ProductRaw]),
						                Volume            = Num([VolumeRaw]),
						                GrossSpend        = Num([GrossRaw]),
						                NetSpend          = Num([NetRaw]),
						                Incentive         = Num([IncentiveRaw]),
						                BilledWeightLbs   = Num([WeightRaw])
						            ]),
						            Out = Table.FromRecords(Table.Column(Shaped, "Rec"))
						        in
						            Out,
						
						    // --- Schema B: March / April "VnS" layout ------------------------------
						    //   Column2  Sub-Parent Number  Column3  Sub-Parent Name
						    //   Column4  Account Number     Column5  Account Name
						    //   Column7  City               Column8  State           Column9  ZIP
						    //   Column10 Product            Column11 Volume
						    //   Column12 Package Billed Weight Lbs
						    //   Column14 Gross Spend        Column15 Net Spend
						    ReadSchemaB = (sheet as table, monthNo as number) as table =>
						        let
						            Rows = Table.Skip(sheet, 5),
						            Pick = Table.SelectColumns(Rows, {
						                "Column2", "Column3", "Column4", "Column5", "Column7", "Column8",
						                "Column9", "Column10", "Column11", "Column12", "Column14", "Column15"}),
						            Named = Table.RenameColumns(Pick, {
						                {"Column2", "SubNumberRaw"}, {"Column3", "SubNameRaw"},
						                {"Column4", "AccountNumberRaw"}, {"Column5", "AccountNameRaw"},
						                {"Column7", "CityRaw"}, {"Column8", "StateRaw"},
						                {"Column9", "ZipRaw"}, {"Column10", "ProductRaw"},
						                {"Column11", "VolumeRaw"}, {"Column12", "WeightRaw"},
						                {"Column14", "GrossRaw"}, {"Column15", "NetRaw"}}),
						            Kept = Table.SelectRows(Named, each
						                KeepRow([SubNumberRaw], [AccountNumberRaw])
						                and Clean([ProductRaw]) <> ""),
						            Shaped = Table.AddColumn(Kept, "Rec", each [
						                MonthNumber       = monthNo,
						                SubNumber         = Clean([SubNumberRaw]),
						                SubName           = SubNameOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                IsMaskedSubParent = MaskedOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                AccountNumber     = Clean([AccountNumberRaw]),
						                AccountName       = Clean([AccountNameRaw]),
						                City              = Clean([CityRaw]),
						                State             = Clean([StateRaw]),
						                ZIP               = Clean([ZipRaw]),
						                RawProduct        = Clean([ProductRaw]),
						                Volume            = Num([VolumeRaw]),
						                GrossSpend        = Num([GrossRaw]),
						                NetSpend          = Num([NetRaw]),
						                // Schema B has no incentive column; derive it.
						                Incentive         = Num([GrossRaw]) - Num([NetRaw]),
						                BilledWeightLbs   = Num([WeightRaw])
						            ]),
						            Out = Table.FromRecords(Table.Column(Shaped, "Rec"))
						        in
						            Out,
						
						    // --- the four months ---------------------------------------------------
						    Jan = ReadSchemaA("UPS_2025_01_VolumeSpend.xlsx", 1),
						    // Month 2 ONLY. This file also contains January - see the banner note.
						    Feb = ReadSchemaA("UPS_2025_02_VolumeSpend_YTD.xlsx", 2),
						    Mar = ReadSchemaB(
						        Excel.Workbook(File.Contents(p_Folder & "\UPS_2025_03_AllTabs.xlsx"), null, true)
						            {[Item = "VnS", Kind = "Sheet"]}[Data], 3),
						    Apr = ReadSchemaB(FirstSheet("UPS_2025_04_VolumeSpend.xlsx"), 4),
						
						    Combined = Table.Combine({Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr}),
						
						    // --- keys and derived columns ------------------------------------------
						    WithKeys = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(
						                Table.AddColumn(Combined, "Year", each 2025, Int64.Type),
						                "MonthKey", each 2025 * 100 + [MonthNumber], Int64.Type),
						            "AccountKey", each [SubNumber] & "|" & [AccountNumber], type text),
						        "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From(Number.RoundUp([MonthNumber] / 3)), type text),
						
						    WithDate = Table.AddColumn(WithKeys, "DateKey",
						        each #date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), type date),
						
						    WithMonthName = Table.AddColumn(WithDate, "MonthName",
						        each Date.ToText(#date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), "MMM"), type text),
						
						    // --- service mapping ----------------------------------------------------
						    // Join to the VnS half of the bridge. An unmapped product routes to a review
						    // bucket rather than silently inheriting a neighbouring service group.
						    Joined = Table.NestedJoin(WithMonthName, {"RawProduct"},
						        Table.SelectRows(Dim_ServiceMapping, each [SourceSystem] = "VnS"), {"RawProduct"},
						        "Map", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
						    Expanded = Table.ExpandTableColumn(Joined, "Map",
						        {"ServiceGroup", "ServiceGroupShort", "ServiceTier", "Scope",
						         "IncludeInRanking"}),
						    Defaults = Table.TransformColumns(Expanded, {
						        {"ServiceGroup", each if _ = null then "Unmapped - Review" else _, type text},
						        {"ServiceGroupShort", each if _ = null then "Unmapped" else _, type text},
						        {"ServiceTier", each if _ = null then "Unmapped" else _, type text},
						        {"Scope", each if _ = null then "Unknown" else _, type text},
						        {"IncludeInRanking", each if _ = null then "No" else _, type text}}),
						
						    // --- row-level quality flags -------------------------------------------
						    // Kept on the fact so the Data Quality page can quantify what the executive
						    // visuals exclude, rather than the exclusion being invisible in a filter pane.
						    Flags = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(Defaults, "HasVolume",
						                each if [Volume] > 0 then "Yes" else "No", type text),
						            "IsSpendOnlyAdjustment",
						            each if [Volume] <= 0 and Number.Abs([NetSpend]) > 0 then "Yes" else "No", type text),
						        "IsNegativeSpend", each if [NetSpend] < 0 then "Yes" else "No", type text),
						
						    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Flags, {
						        {"MonthNumber", Int64.Type}, {"SubNumber", type text}, {"SubName", type text},
						        {"AccountNumber", type text}, {"AccountName", type text},
						        {"City", type text}, {"State", type text}, {"ZIP", type text},
						        {"RawProduct", type text}, {"Volume", type number},
						        {"GrossSpend", Currency.Type}, {"NetSpend", Currency.Type},
						        {"Incentive", Currency.Type}, {"BilledWeightLbs", type number}})
						in
						    Typed

			annotation PBI_ResultType = Table

				dataType: string

			column ViewType
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 8ae02c5a-9d07-5340-b0c9-85a3b2b55c1a
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: ViewType

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition Fact_TimeInTransit = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    Clean = (v) as text =>
						        let
						            t = if v = null then "" else Text.Trim(Text.From(v))
						        in
						            Text.Trim(if Text.StartsWith(t, "'") then Text.RemoveRange(t, 0, 1) else t),
						
						    Num = (v) as number => if v = null then 0 else (try Number.From(v) otherwise 0),
						
						    KeepRow = (sub, acct) as logical =>
						        let
						            s = Text.Lower(Clean(sub)),
						            a = Text.Lower(Clean(acct))
						        in
						            not (s = "grand total" or s = "total" or a = "grand total" or a = "total")
						            and not (a = "" and s = ""),
						
						    SubNameOf = (numv, namev) as text =>
						        if Clean(numv) = "@@" or Clean(namev) = "@@"
						        then "Unassigned Sub-Parent"
						        else Clean(namev),
						
						    ReadTnT = (fileName as text, monthNo as number) as table =>
						        let
						            Sheet = Excel.Workbook(File.Contents(p_Folder & "\" & fileName), null, true)
						                        {[Item = "TnT", Kind = "Sheet"]}[Data],
						            Rows = Table.Skip(Sheet, 5),
						            Pick = Table.SelectColumns(Rows, {
						                "Column2", "Column3", "Column4", "Column5", "Column7", "Column8",
						                "Column9", "Column10", "Column11", "Column12", "Column13", "Column14"}),
						            Named = Table.RenameColumns(Pick, {
						                {"Column2", "SubNumberRaw"}, {"Column3", "SubNameRaw"},
						                {"Column4", "AccountNumberRaw"}, {"Column5", "AccountNameRaw"},
						                {"Column7", "CityRaw"}, {"Column8", "StateRaw"}, {"Column9", "ZipRaw"},
						                {"Column10", "ProductRaw"}, {"Column11", "MeasuredRaw"},
						                {"Column12", "LateTimeRaw"}, {"Column13", "LateDayRaw"},
						                {"Column14", "TotalLateRaw"}}),
						            Kept = Table.SelectRows(Named, each
						                KeepRow([SubNumberRaw], [AccountNumberRaw])
						                and Clean([ProductRaw]) <> ""),
						            Shaped = Table.AddColumn(Kept, "Rec", each
						                let
						                    LateTime = Num([LateTimeRaw]),
						                    LateDay = Num([LateDayRaw]),
						                    // Trust the components over the supplied total. Where the
						                    // total is absent but the parts are present, rebuild it.
						                    Total = if Num([TotalLateRaw]) = 0 and (LateTime + LateDay) > 0
						                            then LateTime + LateDay
						                            else Num([TotalLateRaw]),
						                    Measured = Num([MeasuredRaw])
						                in [
						                    MonthNumber       = monthNo,
						                    SubNumber         = Clean([SubNumberRaw]),
						                    SubName           = SubNameOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                    AccountNumber     = Clean([AccountNumberRaw]),
						                    AccountName       = Clean([AccountNameRaw]),
						                    City              = Clean([CityRaw]),
						                    State             = Clean([StateRaw]),
						                    ZIP               = Clean([ZipRaw]),
						                    RawProduct        = Clean([ProductRaw]),
						                    PackagesMeasured  = Measured,
						                    LateByTime        = LateTime,
						                    LateByDay         = LateDay,
						                    TotalLate         = Total,
						                    OnTimePackages    = Measured - Total,
						                    ViewType          = "Shipper View"
						                ]),
						            Out = Table.FromRecords(Table.Column(Shaped, "Rec"))
						        in
						            Out,
						
						    Mar = ReadTnT("UPS_2025_03_AllTabs.xlsx", 3),
						
						    Combined = Table.Combine({Mar}),
						
						    WithKeys = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(
						                Table.AddColumn(Combined, "Year", each 2025, Int64.Type),
						                "MonthKey", each 2025 * 100 + [MonthNumber], Int64.Type),
						            "AccountKey", each [SubNumber] & "|" & [AccountNumber], type text),
						        "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From(Number.RoundUp([MonthNumber] / 3)), type text),
						
						    WithDate = Table.AddColumn(WithKeys, "DateKey",
						        each #date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), type date),
						    WithMonthName = Table.AddColumn(WithDate, "MonthName",
						        each Date.ToText(#date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), "MMM"), type text),
						
						    // Join on the TnT half of the bridge. This extract names services completely
						    // differently from Volume & Net Spend ("NEXT DAY AIR" vs
						    // "NDA REG / EXPRESS PKG"), which is exactly why the mapping table is keyed
						    // on (SourceSystem, RawProduct) rather than being a simple lookup.
						    Joined = Table.NestedJoin(WithMonthName, {"RawProduct"},
						        Table.SelectRows(Dim_ServiceMapping, each [SourceSystem] = "TnT"), {"RawProduct"},
						        "Map", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
						    Expanded = Table.ExpandTableColumn(Joined, "Map",
						        {"ServiceGroup", "ServiceGroupShort", "ServiceTier", "Scope",
						         "IncludeInRanking"}),
						    Defaults = Table.TransformColumns(Expanded, {
						        {"ServiceGroup", each if _ = null then "Unmapped - Review" else _, type text},
						        {"ServiceGroupShort", each if _ = null then "Unmapped" else _, type text},
						        {"ServiceTier", each if _ = null then "Unmapped" else _, type text},
						        {"Scope", each if _ = null then "Unknown" else _, type text},
						        {"IncludeInRanking", each if _ = null then "No" else _, type text}}),
						
						    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Defaults, {
						        {"MonthNumber", Int64.Type}, {"SubNumber", type text}, {"SubName", type text},
						        {"AccountNumber", type text}, {"AccountName", type text},
						        {"City", type text}, {"State", type text}, {"ZIP", type text},
						        {"RawProduct", type text}, {"PackagesMeasured", type number},
						        {"LateByTime", type number}, {"LateByDay", type number},
						        {"TotalLate", type number}, {"OnTimePackages", type number}})
						in
						    Typed

			annotation PBI_ResultType = Table

			partition Fact_Claims = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    Clean = (v) as text =>
						        let
						            t = if v = null then "" else Text.Trim(Text.From(v))
						        in
						            Text.Trim(if Text.StartsWith(t, "'") then Text.RemoveRange(t, 0, 1) else t),
						
						    Num = (v) as number => if v = null then 0 else (try Number.From(v) otherwise 0),
						
						    KeepRow = (sub, acct) as logical =>
						        let
						            s = Text.Lower(Clean(sub)),
						            a = Text.Lower(Clean(acct))
						        in
						            not (s = "grand total" or s = "total" or a = "grand total" or a = "total")
						            and not (a = "" and s = ""),
						
						    SubNameOf = (numv, namev) as text =>
						        if Clean(numv) = "@@" or Clean(namev) = "@@"
						        then "Unassigned Sub-Parent"
						        else Clean(namev),
						
						    ReadClaims = (fileName as text, monthNo as number) as table =>
						        let
						            Sheet = Excel.Workbook(File.Contents(p_Folder & "\" & fileName), null, true)
						                        {[Item = "Claims", Kind = "Sheet"]}[Data],
						            Rows = Table.Skip(Sheet, 5),
						            Pick = Table.SelectColumns(Rows, {
						                "Column2", "Column3", "Column4", "Column5", "Column6", "Column7",
						                "Column8", "Column10", "Column11", "Column13", "Column14",
						                "Column16", "Column17"}),
						            Named = Table.RenameColumns(Pick, {
						                {"Column2", "SubNumberRaw"}, {"Column3", "SubNameRaw"},
						                {"Column4", "AccountNumberRaw"}, {"Column5", "AccountNameRaw"},
						                {"Column6", "CategoryRaw"}, {"Column7", "IssuedQtyRaw"},
						                {"Column8", "IssuedPkgRaw"}, {"Column10", "PaidQtyRaw"},
						                {"Column11", "PaidPkgRaw"}, {"Column13", "RegQtyRaw"},
						                {"Column14", "RegPkgRaw"}, {"Column16", "PaidAmtRaw"},
						                {"Column17", "DeclaredRaw"}}),
						            // Blank category rows are report padding, not claim activity.
						            Kept = Table.SelectRows(Named, each
						                KeepRow([SubNumberRaw], [AccountNumberRaw])
						                and Clean([CategoryRaw]) <> ""),
						            Shaped = Table.AddColumn(Kept, "Rec", each [
						                MonthNumber            = monthNo,
						                SubNumber              = Clean([SubNumberRaw]),
						                SubName                = SubNameOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                AccountNumber          = Clean([AccountNumberRaw]),
						                AccountName            = Clean([AccountNameRaw]),
						                ClaimsCategory         = Clean([CategoryRaw]),
						                IsLoss                 = if Text.Lower(Clean([CategoryRaw])) = "loss"
						                                         then "Yes" else "No",
						                IssuedClaimsQty        = Num([IssuedQtyRaw]),
						                IssuedClaimsPkgQty     = Num([IssuedPkgRaw]),
						                PaidClaimsQty          = Num([PaidQtyRaw]),
						                PaidClaimsPkgQty       = Num([PaidPkgRaw]),
						                RegisteredClaimsQty    = Num([RegQtyRaw]),
						                RegisteredClaimsPkgQty = Num([RegPkgRaw]),
						                PaidClaimsAmount       = Num([PaidAmtRaw]),
						                ClaimsDeclaredValue    = Num([DeclaredRaw]),
						                // Stamped on every row so the limitation travels with the data
						                // into any export, drillthrough or copied visual.
						                ServiceAttribution     = "Not Available"
						            ]),
						            Out = Table.FromRecords(Table.Column(Shaped, "Rec"))
						        in
						            Out,
						
						    Mar = ReadClaims("UPS_2025_03_AllTabs.xlsx", 3),
						    Combined = Table.Combine({Mar}),
						
						    WithKeys = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(
						                Table.AddColumn(Combined, "Year", each 2025, Int64.Type),
						                "MonthKey", each 2025 * 100 + [MonthNumber], Int64.Type),
						            "AccountKey", each [SubNumber] & "|" & [AccountNumber], type text),
						        "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From(Number.RoundUp([MonthNumber] / 3)), type text),
						    WithDate = Table.AddColumn(WithKeys, "DateKey",
						        each #date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), type date),
						    WithMonthName = Table.AddColumn(WithDate, "MonthName",
						        each Date.ToText(#date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), "MMM"), type text),
						
						    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(WithMonthName, {
						        {"MonthNumber", Int64.Type}, {"SubNumber", type text}, {"SubName", type text},
						        {"AccountNumber", type text}, {"AccountName", type text},
						        {"ClaimsCategory", type text}, {"IsLoss", type text},
						        {"IssuedClaimsQty", type number}, {"IssuedClaimsPkgQty", type number},
						        {"PaidClaimsQty", type number}, {"PaidClaimsPkgQty", type number},
						        {"RegisteredClaimsQty", type number}, {"RegisteredClaimsPkgQty", type number},
						        {"PaidClaimsAmount", Currency.Type}, {"ClaimsDeclaredValue", Currency.Type}})
						in
						    Typed

				dataType: double

			column SourceFile
				dataType: string
				isHidden
				lineageTag: 2dc46f94-07e4-5e52-ba4a-35f797f876c9
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: SourceFile

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition Fact_Accessorial = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    Clean = (v) as text =>
						        let
						            t = if v = null then "" else Text.Trim(Text.From(v))
						        in
						            Text.Trim(if Text.StartsWith(t, "'") then Text.RemoveRange(t, 0, 1) else t),
						
						    Num = (v) as number => if v = null then 0 else (try Number.From(v) otherwise 0),
						
						    KeepRow = (sub, acct) as logical =>
						        let
						            s = Text.Lower(Clean(sub)),
						            a = Text.Lower(Clean(acct))
						        in
						            not (s = "grand total" or s = "total" or a = "grand total" or a = "total")
						            and not (a = "" and s = ""),
						
						    SubNameOf = (numv, namev) as text =>
						        if Clean(numv) = "@@" or Clean(namev) = "@@"
						        then "Unassigned Sub-Parent"
						        else Clean(namev),
						
						    ReadAcc = (fileName as text, monthNo as number) as table =>
						        let
						            Sheet = Excel.Workbook(File.Contents(p_Folder & "\" & fileName), null, true)
						                        {[Item = "Accessorial", Kind = "Sheet"]}[Data],
						            Rows = Table.Skip(Sheet, 5),
						            Pick = Table.SelectColumns(Rows, {
						                "Column2", "Column3", "Column4", "Column5", "Column8", "Column10",
						                "Column11", "Column12", "Column13", "Column14", "Column15", "Column16"}),
						            Named = Table.RenameColumns(Pick, {
						                {"Column2", "SubNumberRaw"}, {"Column3", "SubNameRaw"},
						                {"Column4", "AccountNumberRaw"}, {"Column5", "AccountNameRaw"},
						                {"Column8", "StateRaw"}, {"Column10", "ProductRaw"},
						                {"Column11", "FreightTypeRaw"}, {"Column12", "ChargeRaw"},
						                {"Column13", "UnitsRaw"}, {"Column14", "AccSpendRaw"},
						                {"Column15", "GrossRaw"}, {"Column16", "NetRaw"}}),
						            Kept = Table.SelectRows(Named, each
						                KeepRow([SubNumberRaw], [AccountNumberRaw])
						                and Clean([ChargeRaw]) <> ""),
						            Shaped = Table.AddColumn(Kept, "Rec", each [
						                MonthNumber            = monthNo,
						                SubNumber              = Clean([SubNumberRaw]),
						                SubName                = SubNameOf([SubNumberRaw], [SubNameRaw]),
						                AccountNumber          = Clean([AccountNumberRaw]),
						                AccountName            = Clean([AccountNameRaw]),
						                State                  = Clean([StateRaw]),
						                RawProduct             = Clean([ProductRaw]),
						                FreightTypeDescription = Clean([FreightTypeRaw]),
						                ChargeCategory         = Clean([ChargeRaw]),
						                IsAccessorial          = if Text.Upper(Clean([FreightTypeRaw])) = "ACCESSORIAL"
						                                         then "Yes" else "No",
						                NumberOfUnits          = Num([UnitsRaw]),
						                AccessorialSpend       = Num([AccSpendRaw]),
						                GrossSpend             = Num([GrossRaw]),
						                NetSpend               = Num([NetRaw])
						            ]),
						            Out = Table.FromRecords(Table.Column(Shaped, "Rec"))
						        in
						            Out,
						
						    Mar = ReadAcc("UPS_2025_03_AllTabs.xlsx", 3),
						    Combined = Table.Combine({Mar}),
						
						    WithKeys = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(
						                Table.AddColumn(Combined, "Year", each 2025, Int64.Type),
						                "MonthKey", each 2025 * 100 + [MonthNumber], Int64.Type),
						            "AccountKey", each [SubNumber] & "|" & [AccountNumber], type text),
						        "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From(Number.RoundUp([MonthNumber] / 3)), type text),
						    WithDate = Table.AddColumn(WithKeys, "DateKey",
						        each #date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), type date),
						    WithMonthName = Table.AddColumn(WithDate, "MonthName",
						        each Date.ToText(#date(2025, [MonthNumber], 1), "MMM"), type text),
						
						    Joined = Table.NestedJoin(WithMonthName, {"RawProduct"},
						        Table.SelectRows(Dim_ServiceMapping, each [SourceSystem] = "VnS"), {"RawProduct"},
						        "Map", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
						    Expanded = Table.ExpandTableColumn(Joined, "Map",
						        {"ServiceGroup", "ServiceGroupShort"}),
						    Defaults = Table.TransformColumns(Expanded, {
						        {"ServiceGroup", each if _ = null then "Unmapped - Review" else _, type text},
						        {"ServiceGroupShort", each if _ = null then "Unmapped" else _, type text}}),
						
						    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Defaults, {
						        {"MonthNumber", Int64.Type}, {"NumberOfUnits", type number},
						        {"AccessorialSpend", Currency.Type}, {"GrossSpend", Currency.Type},
						        {"NetSpend", Currency.Type}})
						in
						    Typed

			annotation PBI_ResultType = Table

				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 9bd91905-9892-52e4-8346-2f72460fb35a

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column IsLoaded
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: d835e449-d590-53c3-a2b6-51a0f02b9af9
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: IsLoaded

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column IsReportable
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 8d4ed47e-f273-5c6a-aaeb-0094d9bb2d84
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: IsReportable

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column SortOrder
				dataType: int64
				isHidden
				lineageTag: 62750676-025e-5dfe-b681-cc97d8f03013
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: SortOrder

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition Dim_Date = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    ReportYear = 2025,
						    // Months present in the data. Update as later months are added, or set to
						    // {1..12} once the full year is loaded.
						    LoadedMonths = {1, 2, 3, 4},
						    // Anchors the completed-month flag. Change to a fixed date to reproduce a
						    // previously published figure.
						    AsOf = DateTime.Date(DateTime.LocalNow()),
						
						    Rows = List.Transform({1 .. 12}, (m) =>
						        let
						            First = #date(ReportYear, m, 1),
						            Last = Date.EndOfMonth(First),
						            Completed = Last < AsOf,
						            Loaded = List.Contains(LoadedMonths, m)
						        in [
						            DateKey          = First,
						            Year             = ReportYear,
						            MonthNumber      = m,
						            MonthName        = Date.ToText(First, "MMM"),
						            MonthNameLong    = Date.ToText(First, "MMMM"),
						            MonthKey         = ReportYear * 100 + m,
						            MonthYearLabel   = Date.ToText(First, "MMM yyyy"),
						            Quarter          = "Q" & Text.From(Number.RoundUp(m / 3)),
						            QuarterKey       = ReportYear * 10 + Number.RoundUp(m / 3),
						            MonthEndDate     = Last,
						            IsCompletedMonth = if Completed then "Yes" else "No",
						            IsLoaded         = if Loaded then "Yes" else "No",
						            // The only flag that should gate a trend or annual comparison: the
						            // month has both ended and actually been loaded.
						            IsReportable     = if Completed and Loaded then "Yes" else "No",
						            SortOrder        = ReportYear * 100 + m
						        ]),
						
						    Result = Table.FromRecords(Rows, type table [
						        DateKey = date, Year = Int64.Type, MonthNumber = Int64.Type,
						        MonthName = text, MonthNameLong = text, MonthKey = Int64.Type,
						        MonthYearLabel = text, Quarter = text, QuarterKey = Int64.Type,
						        MonthEndDate = date, IsCompletedMonth = text, IsLoaded = text,
						        IsReportable = text, SortOrder = Int64.Type])
						in
						    Result

				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 2a7dbd9f-64b0-5347-8220-cea4b18005ad

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column State
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 2d24e06d-2654-5b06-9aa7-126c6c45761d
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: State

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column ZIP
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 9fc56ad1-6d67-54c0-9d69-e3838493cb6a
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: ZIP

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column PresentIn
				dataType: string
				isHidden
				lineageTag: a05a04c3-ddc2-5951-ab0f-ff1ea0613e81
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: PresentIn

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column HasTransitData
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 205a86d5-dcf9-539a-8ed6-aecea85ae9f0
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: HasTransitData

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column HasClaimsData
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 6304fc43-bb7b-52de-af14-13482ff69933
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: HasClaimsData

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			column Region
				dataType: string
				lineageTag: 66bd3f40-b1a1-597e-ac7d-3fbb3414171a
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: Region

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition Dim_Account = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    FromVolume = Table.SelectColumns(Fact_VolumeSpend,
						        {"AccountKey", "SubNumber", "SubName", "AccountNumber", "AccountName",
						         "City", "State", "ZIP"}),
						    FromTransit = Table.SelectColumns(Fact_TimeInTransit,
						        {"AccountKey", "SubNumber", "SubName", "AccountNumber", "AccountName",
						         "City", "State", "ZIP"}),
						    // The claims extract carries no geography; pad so the columns align.
						    FromClaims = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(
						            Table.AddColumn(
						                Table.SelectColumns(Fact_Claims,
						                    {"AccountKey", "SubNumber", "SubName", "AccountNumber", "AccountName"}),
						                "City", each "", type text),
						            "State", each "", type text),
						        "ZIP", each "", type text),
						
						    Combined = Table.Combine({FromVolume, FromTransit, FromClaims}),
						
						    // Blank attributes must not win the deduplication. Sorting non-blank State
						    // and City first means the surviving row carries the populated geography,
						    // which the claims rows do not supply.
						    Ranked = Table.Sort(Combined, {
						        {"AccountKey", Order.Ascending},
						        {each if [State] = null or [State] = "" then 1 else 0, Order.Ascending},
						        {each if [City] = null or [City] = "" then 1 else 0, Order.Ascending}}),
						
						    // Table.Buffer is required: without it the sort is not guaranteed to be
						    // honoured by Table.Distinct and the wrong row can win.
						    Distinct = Table.Distinct(Table.Buffer(Ranked), {"AccountKey"}),
						
						    WithRegion = Table.AddColumn(Distinct, "Region", each
						        let S = Text.Upper(if [State] = null then "" else [State]) in
						        if List.Contains({"CT","ME","MA","NH","RI","VT","NJ","NY","PA"}, S) then "Northeast"
						        else if List.Contains({"IL","IN","MI","OH","WI","IA","KS","MN","MO",
						                               "NE","ND","SD"}, S) then "Midwest"
						        else if List.Contains({"DE","FL","GA","MD","NC","SC","VA","DC","WV","AL","KY","MS",
						                               "TN","AR","LA","OK","TX"}, S) then "South"
						        else if List.Contains({"AZ","CO","ID","MT","NV","NM","UT","WY","AK",
						                               "CA","HI","OR","WA"}, S) then "West"
						        else "Unknown / International", type text),
						
						    // Coverage flags. Built from buffered key lists rather than a nested
						    // Table.SelectRows per row: the nested form re-scans the whole fact table
						    // for every account, and inside the inner lambda [AccountKey] is ambiguous
						    // between the outer and inner row.
						    TransitKeys = List.Buffer(List.Distinct(Table.Column(Fact_TimeInTransit, "AccountKey"))),
						    ClaimsKeys  = List.Buffer(List.Distinct(Table.Column(Fact_Claims, "AccountKey"))),
						
						    WithFlags = Table.AddColumn(
						        Table.AddColumn(WithRegion, "HasTransitData",
						            each if List.Contains(TransitKeys, [AccountKey]) then "Yes" else "No", type text),
						        "HasClaimsData",
						            each if List.Contains(ClaimsKeys, [AccountKey]) then "Yes" else "No", type text),
						
						    WithDisplay = Table.AddColumn(WithFlags, "AccountDisplay",
						        each [AccountName] & " (" & [AccountNumber] & ")", type text),
						
						    Sorted = Table.Sort(WithDisplay,
						        {{"SubName", Order.Ascending}, {"AccountName", Order.Ascending}})
						in
						    Sorted

			annotation PBI_ResultType = Table

			column ServicePriority
				dataType: int64

			partition Dim_Service = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    Source = Dim_ServiceMapping,
						    Trimmed = Table.SelectColumns(Source, {
						        "ServiceGroup", "ServiceGroupShort", "ServiceTier", "Scope",
						        "IncludeInRanking", "ServicePriority"}),
						    Distinct = Table.Distinct(Trimmed, {"ServiceGroup"}),
						    // A review bucket so an unmapped fact row finds a parent instead of becoming
						    // a blank-key orphan on every visual.
						    WithReview = Table.Combine({Distinct, #table(
						        type table [ServiceGroup = text, ServiceGroupShort = text,
						                    ServiceTier = text,
						                    Scope = text, IncludeInRanking = text, ServicePriority = Int64.Type],
						        {{"Unmapped - Review", "Unmapped", "Unmapped", "Unknown", "No", 98}})}),
						    Deduped = Table.Distinct(WithReview, {"ServiceGroup"}),
						    Sorted = Table.Sort(Deduped, {{"ServicePriority", Order.Ascending}})
						in
						    Sorted

			annotation PBI_ResultType = Table

			measure 'Total Shipments' = SUM ( Fact_VolumeSpend[Volume] )
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
				lineageTag: 9ee6c617-c6d2-56db-b2fe-9c3a1c34c551

			measure 'Rankable Shipments' =
					
					CALCULATE (
					    [Total Shipments],
					    KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_VolumeSpend[IncludeInRanking] = "Yes" ),
					    KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_VolumeSpend[HasVolume] = "Yes" )
					)
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
				lineageTag: 4cca2c13-58a0-5434-8ee6-f3693de3598c

			measure 'YTD Shipments' =
					
					VAR CurrentYear = MAX ( Dim_Date[Year] )
					VAR CurrentMonth = MAX ( Dim_Date[MonthNumber] )
					RETURN
					    CALCULATE (
					        [Total Shipments],
					        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
					        Dim_Date[Year] = CurrentYear,
					        Dim_Date[MonthNumber] <= CurrentMonth
					    )
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
				lineageTag: 382275f9-36ad-5be9-bf5a-6c58166b73c7

			measure 'Shipments PY' =
					
					VAR PriorKeys =
					    SELECTCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] ), "@Key", Dim_Date[MonthKey] - 100 )
					RETURN
					    CALCULATE (
					        [Total Shipments],
					        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
					        TREATAS ( PriorKeys, Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
					    )
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
				lineageTag: 9ad8c10d-bc5d-5881-89ba-4d7a6e0ab3ad

			measure 'Shipments YoY %' =
					
					VAR Current = [Total Shipments]
					VAR Prior = [Shipments PY]
					RETURN
					    DIVIDE ( Current - Prior, Prior )

			measure 'Weight-Adjusted Cost Premium' =

					        [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb],

					        VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] )

					RETURN
					    DIVIDE ( [Total Net Spend] - ExpectedSpend, ExpectedSpend )
				formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%

			measure 'OTD % PM' =
					
					VAR CurrentKey = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
					VAR PriorKey =
					    IF ( MOD ( CurrentKey, 100 ) = 1, CurrentKey - 89, CurrentKey - 1 )
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        NOT ISBLANK ( CurrentKey ),
					        CALCULATE (
					            [On-Time Delivery %],
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
					            Dim_Date[MonthKey] = PriorKey
					        )
					    )
				formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
				lineageTag: c548de76-2123-5155-999d-437910daa3ee

					RETURN

				formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%

			measure 'OTD Volatility (pp)' =
					
					VAR MonthlySeries =
					    ADDCOLUMNS (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] ),
					            Dim_Date[IsReportable] = "Yes"
					        ),
					        "@OTD", [On-Time Delivery %]
					    )
					VAR Clean = FILTER ( MonthlySeries, NOT ISBLANK ( [@OTD] ) )
					RETURN
					    IF ( COUNTROWS ( Clean ) >= 2, STDEVX.P ( Clean, [@OTD] ) * 100 )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
				lineageTag: c4247a76-f99f-5264-8397-49eb7c160ee2

			measure 'Worst OTD Month' =
					
					VAR MonthlySeries =
					    ADDCOLUMNS (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ),
					            Dim_Date[IsReportable] = "Yes"
					        ),
					        "@OTD", [On-Time Delivery %]
					    )
					VAR Clean = FILTER ( MonthlySeries, NOT ISBLANK ( [@OTD] ) )
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        NOT ISEMPTY ( Clean ),
					        CONCATENATEX (
					            TOPN ( 1, Clean, [@OTD], ASC ),
					            Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] & " (" & FORMAT ( [@OTD], "0.0%" ) & ")"
					        )
					    )
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
				lineageTag: ec9cab1c-4d2b-5d3e-b9d1-09c265a9bad2

			measure 'OTD Wilson Lower Bound' =
					
					VAR N = [Packages Measured]
					VAR Successes = [On-Time Packages]
					VAR Z = 1.96                                  // 95% two-sided
					VAR P = DIVIDE ( Successes, N )
					VAR Denominator = 1 + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, N )
					VAR Centre = P + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, 2 * N )
					VAR Margin =
					    Z * SQRT ( DIVIDE ( P * ( 1 - P ), N ) + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, 4 * N * N ) )
					RETURN
					    IF ( N > 0, DIVIDE ( Centre - Margin, Denominator ) )
				formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
				lineageTag: 6f5d05dc-cb1e-50b7-968d-8da00be6ce32

			measure 'OTD Confidence Gap (pp)' =
					
					VAR Gap = [On-Time Delivery %] - [OTD Wilson Lower Bound]
					RETURN
					    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Gap ), Gap * 100 )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
				lineageTag: e41d2933-0c38-5749-8634-4432112b936e

			measure 'OTD Confidence Label' =
					
					VAR Gap = [OTD Confidence Gap (pp)]
					RETURN
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        ISBLANK ( Gap ), "No transit data",
					        Gap <= 0.5, "High confidence",
					        Gap <= 2.0, "Moderate confidence",
					        Gap <= 10.0, "Low confidence - small sample",
					        "Not interpretable - sample too small"
					    )
				displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Coverage
				lineageTag: 2b53a1bc-9396-5bbe-b6bf-887e7cdc11c4

					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        ISBLANK ( [Loss Claims] ) || [Loss Claims] = 0, "No loss activity",
					        Vol < 500, "Insufficient volume to rate",
					        Idx >= 3, "Critical - investigate",
					        Idx >= 2, "Elevated - monitor",
					        Idx >= 1, "Above firm average",
					        "At or below firm average"
					    )
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Concentration
				lineageTag: 1264bb43-643c-5969-9092-b6578a8a8a51

			measure 'Top Account Share of Loss Claims' =
					
					VAR ByAccount =
					    ADDCOLUMNS (
					        CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountKey] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Account ) ),
					        "@Loss", [Loss Claims]
					    )
					VAR TotalLoss = SUMX ( ByAccount, [@Loss] )
					VAR TopLoss = MAXX ( ByAccount, [@Loss] )
					RETURN
					    DIVIDE ( TopLoss, TotalLoss )
				formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Concentration
				lineageTag: b874cac7-b86d-565e-bb60-a3ae481a29c5

			measure 'Top Account by Loss Claims' =
					
					VAR ByAccount =
					    ADDCOLUMNS (
					        CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountName] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Account ) ),
					        "@Loss", [Loss Claims]
					    )
					RETURN
					    CONCATENATEX ( TOPN ( 1, ByAccount, [@Loss], DESC ), Dim_Account[AccountName] )
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
				lineageTag: 8ea4314d-5ffc-5d8a-9ac3-fd04635eadbd

			measure 'Loss Claims (Allocated Proxy)' =
					
					SUMX (
					    VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountKey] ),
					    VAR AccountLoss = CALCULATE ( [Loss Claims], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					    VAR AccountVolumeAllServices =
					        CALCULATE ( [Rankable Shipments], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					    VAR VolumeInScope = [Rankable Shipments]
					    RETURN
					        AccountLoss * DIVIDE ( VolumeInScope, AccountVolumeAllServices )
					)
				formatString: #,0.0
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
				lineageTag: ffcd1448-72dc-57a8-b1b7-e6372778649d

			measure 'Loss Claim Rate per 10k (Allocated Proxy)' =
					
					DIVIDE ( [Loss Claims (Allocated Proxy)], [Rankable Shipments] ) * 10000
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
				lineageTag: 73f2b0b1-7fab-5419-92f6-4c81d5c7182d

			measure 'Claims Attribution Warning' =
					
					"Allocated estimate. The claims extract carries no service or tracking key; "
					    & "account-level claims are distributed across services by shipment volume. "
					    & "Not a measured service-level loss rate. Do not use for service selection."
				displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
				lineageTag: 017d3b78-6f60-5e74-9fc7-729fd3c6d0ce

			measure 'Minimum Shipment Threshold' = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Volume Threshold'[Volume Threshold], 1000 )
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: 4f827bc4-10f8-54fb-b45b-0e2d70fb4c73

			measure 'Minimum Volume Share' = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Share Threshold'[Share Threshold], 0.01 )
				formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: 332cca93-15be-598a-a214-6162c4881f38

			measure 'Minimum Measured Packages' = 384
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: 1c0ec210-b833-59e1-abcd-70d209c04136

			measure 'Service Volume Share' =
					
					DIVIDE (
					    [Rankable Shipments],
					    CALCULATE ( [Rankable Shipments], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					)
				formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: b2e9bac8-c180-5fdb-9a8d-ce10b0fd1635

			measure 'Annual Qualification Flag' =
					
					VAR MeetsAbsolute = [Rankable Shipments] >= [Minimum Shipment Threshold]
					VAR MeetsShare = [Service Volume Share] >= [Minimum Volume Share]
					VAR MeetsMeasurement = [Packages Measured] >= [Minimum Measured Packages]
					
					
					
					VAR IsRankableService = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[IncludeInRanking] ) = "Yes"
					RETURN
					    IF ( MeetsAbsolute && MeetsShare && MeetsMeasurement && IsRankableService, 1, 0 )
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: aed5f62a-3ebc-581a-8c72-98ea473f0b1a

			measure 'Qualification Status' =
					
					VAR Vol = [Rankable Shipments]
					VAR Measured = [Packages Measured]
					RETURN
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1, "Qualified",
					        ISBLANK ( Vol ) || Vol = 0, "No shipment volume",
					        Measured < [Minimum Measured Packages],
					            "Transit sample too small (" & FORMAT ( Measured, "#,0" ) & " measured, "
					                & FORMAT ( [Minimum Measured Packages], "#,0" ) & " required)",
					        Vol < [Minimum Shipment Threshold],
					            "Below volume floor (" & FORMAT ( Vol, "#,0" ) & " of "
					                & FORMAT ( [Minimum Shipment Threshold], "#,0" ) & ")",
					        [Service Volume Share] < [Minimum Volume Share],
					            "Below " & FORMAT ( [Minimum Volume Share], "0.0%" ) & " volume share",
					        "Excluded from ranking by service mapping"
					    )
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: a01d7726-fe53-53c8-8575-8c336aeef00d

			measure 'Qualified Service Count' =
					
					COUNTROWS (
					    FILTER (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					        ),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					    )
					)
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
				lineageTag: e62a3c61-fc29-5ef7-b8f9-8c318a5b5202

			measure 'Claims Service Key Available' = 0
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
				lineageTag: a34c1687-c1a3-5d3d-af91-18d6b03d98e8

			measure 'Score - Reliability' =
					
					VAR QualifiedSet =
					    FILTER (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					        ),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					    )
					VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [OTD Wilson Lower Bound] )
					VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
					VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR Self = [OTD Wilson Lower Bound]
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ),
					        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
					    )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
				lineageTag: cb02405a-df05-57fb-bf31-a17d2c2bab60

			measure 'Score - Loss Risk' =
					
					VAR QualifiedSet =
					    FILTER (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					        ),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					    )
					VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Loss Claim Rate per 10k] )
					VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
					VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR Self = [Loss Claim Rate per 10k]
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ) && [Claims Service Key Available] = 1,
					        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
					    )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
				lineageTag: 27d5388f-911b-51ef-831f-df2ff41eb193

			measure 'Score - Exception Risk' =
					
					VAR QualifiedSet =
					    FILTER (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					        ),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					    )
					VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Claims Rate per 10k] )
					VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
					VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR Self = [Claims Rate per 10k]
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ) && [Claims Service Key Available] = 1,
					        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
					    )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
				lineageTag: f5dd1b52-aaad-5047-b913-420cdb0e3fea

			measure 'Score - Cost' =
					
					VAR QualifiedSet =
					    FILTER (
					        CALCULATETABLE (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					        ),
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					    )
					VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb] )
					VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
					VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
					VAR Self = [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb]
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ),
					        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
					    )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: 469e4445-bd69-56b0-9835-fb913324bb0f

			measure 'Weight - Reliability' = 0.40
				formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: cf045b93-7c98-5ad8-90cd-6fbb38f022f7

			measure 'Weight - Loss Risk' = 0.30
				formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: aa2f0729-2870-582a-b56d-527e7b6e1514

			measure 'Weight - Exception Risk' = 0.20
				formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: ad97f364-a7bd-5909-99a9-0362ab8ea597

			measure 'Weight - Cost' = 0.10
				formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: 6589c4f8-5024-57d4-be9a-d5d9056df3bb

			measure 'Effective Weight Total' =
					
					VAR W =
					    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ), [Weight - Reliability], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), [Weight - Loss Risk], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), [Weight - Exception Risk], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), [Weight - Cost], 0 )
					RETURN
					    IF ( W > 0, W )
				formatString: #,0.00
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: 4cc03ab0-4670-546c-8bfb-b7b2ebe7029d

			measure 'Service Consistency Score' =
					
					VAR Weighted =
					    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ), [Score - Reliability] * [Weight - Reliability], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), [Score - Loss Risk] * [Weight - Loss Risk], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), [Score - Exception Risk] * [Weight - Exception Risk], 0 )
					        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), [Score - Cost] * [Weight - Cost], 0 )
					RETURN
					    IF (
					        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1,
					        DIVIDE ( Weighted, [Effective Weight Total] ) * 100
					    )
				formatString: #,0.0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: 6e7c86f2-7df2-5232-8268-e5e737aceac3

			measure 'Score Basis' =
					
					VAR Covered =
					    IF (
					        NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ),
					        "Reliability " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Reliability] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ",
					        ""
					    )
					        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), "Loss risk " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Loss Risk] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ", "" )
					        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), "Exceptions " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Exception Risk] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ", "" )
					        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), "Cost " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Cost] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ), "" )
					VAR Missing =
					    IF ( ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ) || ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ),
					        " | Claims components unavailable at service grain - weights reallocated.", "" )
					RETURN
					    "Effective weights: " & Covered & Missing
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
				lineageTag: e9336c2e-5203-5bfb-9030-0e1c45b5468f

			measure 'Service Rank' =
					
					IF (
					    [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1,
					    RANKX (
					        FILTER (
					            CALCULATETABLE (
					                VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					                REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					            ),
					            [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					        ),
					        [Service Consistency Score],
					        ,
					        DESC,
					        DENSE
					    )
					)
				formatString: #,0
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
				lineageTag: 79da7f14-22f5-582a-8238-33a4501e7715

			measure 'Recommendation Category' =
					
					VAR Qualified = [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					VAR QualCount = [Qualified Service Count]
					VAR Tier = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[ServiceTier] )
					VAR Rank = [Service Rank]
					VAR BestPremiumRank =
					    RANKX (
					        FILTER (
					            CALCULATETABLE (
					                VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					                REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					            ),
					            [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					                && SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[ServiceTier] ) = "Premium"
					        ),
					        [OTD Wilson Lower Bound],
					        ,
					        DESC,
					        DENSE
					    )
					VAR IsVolumeAnchor = [Service Volume Share] >= 0.50
					VAR Volatile = [OTD Volatility (pp)] > 1.5
					VAR BelowFirmOTD = [On-Time Delivery %] < CALCULATE ( [On-Time Delivery %], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					RETURN
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        NOT Qualified, "Not ranked - " & [Qualification Status],
					        QualCount <= 1, "Single qualified service - no comparison possible",
					        // The service the firm actually runs on. It is the default by
					        // economics; the question the dashboard answers is whether its
					        // reliability is acceptable, not whether to replace it.
					        IsVolumeAnchor && BelowFirmOTD, "Volume anchor - reliability below firm average, monitor",
					        IsVolumeAnchor, "Recommended default service",
					        Rank = 1 && Tier <> "Premium", "Recommended default service",
					        Rank = 1, "Best overall performer",
					        BestPremiumRank = 1, "Recommended premium service",
					        Volatile, "Service to monitor - inconsistent month to month",
					        "Qualified alternative"
					    )
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
				lineageTag: 3881f2c7-7537-5fe4-802a-08f55a4c27af

			measure 'Recommendation Callout' =
					
					VAR MonthsCovered = [Months with Transit Data]
					VAR BestService =
					    CONCATENATEX (
					        TOPN (
					            1,
					            FILTER (
					                CALCULATETABLE (
					                    VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					                    REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
					                ),
					                [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
					            ),
					            [Service Consistency Score],
					            DESC
					        ),
					        Dim_Service[ServiceGroup]
					    )
					VAR FirmOTD = CALCULATE ( [On-Time Delivery %], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					RETURN
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        MonthsCovered = 0,
					            "No Time-in-Transit data loaded. Reliability cannot be assessed and no service recommendation can be made.",
					        MonthsCovered < 6,
					            "PROVISIONAL - based on " & MonthsCovered & " month(s) of Time-in-Transit data. "
					                & "Highest-scoring qualified service: " & BestService & ". "
					                & "Firm-wide on-time delivery " & FORMAT ( FirmOTD, "0.0%" ) & ". "
					                & "Do not issue as an annual service policy until at least six completed months are loaded.",
					        "Highest-scoring qualified service: " & BestService & ". Firm-wide on-time delivery "
					            & FORMAT ( FirmOTD, "0.0%" ) & " across " & MonthsCovered & " months."
					    )
				displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
				lineageTag: fec5dd20-7de7-5040-8762-2a3ee5e1d4af

				formatString: \$#,0
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Reconciliation
				lineageTag: 28027189-8a3d-5559-ad98-2689c0268fcf

			measure 'Spend Reconciliation Variance' =
					
					VAR VolumeSpendTotal =
					    CALCULATE ( SUM ( Fact_VolumeSpend[NetSpend] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					VAR AccessorialTotal =
					    CALCULATE ( [Accessorial Net Spend], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
					RETURN
					    IF ( AccessorialTotal <> 0, VolumeSpendTotal - AccessorialTotal )
				formatString: \$#,0.00
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Reconciliation
				lineageTag: a6f0d05c-ed24-52cc-87d9-ea301210d648

			measure 'Reconciliation Status' =
					
					VAR Variance = [Spend Reconciliation Variance]
					RETURN
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        ISBLANK ( Variance ), "No accessorial detail for this period",
					        ABS ( Variance ) < 1, "Reconciled",
					        ABS ( Variance ) < 100, "Rounding variance - " & FORMAT ( Variance, "$#,0.00" ),
					        "VARIANCE - " & FORMAT ( Variance, "$#,0.00" ) & " - investigate before publishing"
					    )
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Reconciliation
				lineageTag: 32212800-1316-579d-844a-2bfabbf2aa97

			measure 'Measured vs Billed Coverage %' = DIVIDE ( [Packages Measured], [Rankable Shipments] )
				formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Banner narrative
				lineageTag: a0c5fbab-b86e-5872-8ede-daac1b8267bf

			measure 'Data Basis Banner' =
					
					VAR VolMonths = [Volume Months Covered]
					VAR TransitMonths = [Transit Months Covered]
					VAR ClaimsMonths = [Claims Months Covered]
					VAR Missing = [Missing Months List]
					VAR Recon = [Reconciliation Status]
					VAR Severity =
					    SWITCH (
					        TRUE (),
					        TransitMonths = 0, "NO RELIABILITY DATA",
					        TransitMonths < 6 || ClaimsMonths < 6, "PROVISIONAL",
					        VolMonths < 12, "PARTIAL YEAR",
					        "ANNUAL"
					    )
					RETURN
					    Severity & " - " & [Coverage Summary]
					        & IF ( LEN ( Missing ) > 0, "  |  Not yet loaded: " & Missing, "" )
					        & IF ( Recon <> "Reconciled" && LEFT ( Recon, 2 ) = "VA", "  |  " & Recon, "" )
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Banner narrative
				lineageTag: d46e7952-f09f-5377-85e0-b17d9f010de0

			measure 'Data Basis Banner Colour' =
					
					SWITCH (
					    TRUE (),
					    [Transit Months Covered] = 0, "#B3261E",
					    [Transit Months Covered] < 6 || [Claims Months Covered] < 6, "#B26B00",
					    [Volume Months Covered] < 12, "#5B4B8A",
					    "#1F6F54"
					)
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
				lineageTag: d4896e9e-556c-521d-b694-7ab6d44b6ad2

			measure 'Title - Executive Overview' =
					
					VAR Period =
					    IF (
					        ISFILTERED ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ) || ISFILTERED ( Dim_Date[Quarter] ),
					        CONCATENATEX (
					            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ),
					            Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel], ", ", Dim_Date[SortOrder], ASC
					        ),
					        SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Date[Year], "2025" ) & " full year"
					    )
					VAR Scope =
					    IF (
					        ISFILTERED ( Dim_Service[Scope] ),
					        SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[Scope], "All scopes" ),
					        "Domestic and international"
					    )
					RETURN
					    "UPS Shipping Performance - " & Period & " - " & Scope
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
				lineageTag: d15d733d-06b8-5bd3-8af4-3eb5f161fb55

			measure 'Title - Service Scorecard' =
					
					"Service scorecard - " & [Qualified Service Count] & " of "
					    & CALCULATE (
					        DISTINCTCOUNT ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
					        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ),
					        Dim_Service[IncludeInRanking] = "Yes"
					    )
					    & " services qualify at "
					    & FORMAT ( [Minimum Shipment Threshold], "#,0" ) & " shipments / "
					    & FORMAT ( [Minimum Volume Share], "0.0%" ) & " share"
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
				lineageTag: 5a00b173-86b2-59f9-b71f-aaedcd0de940

			measure 'Title - Claims' =
					
					"Claims and loss risk - account level only ("
					    & [Claims Months Covered] & " month(s) loaded). "
					    & "Claims carry no service key."
				displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
				lineageTag: c2abcf63-def0-50a8-ba6a-f6be55e6cb92

			column _
				dataType: int64
				isHidden
				lineageTag: 0fc0f418-2d98-55fe-b0a6-39af2a8c9e05
				summarizeBy: none
				sourceColumn: _

				annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

			partition _Measures = m
				mode: import
				source =
						let
						    Source = #table(type table [_ = Int64.Type], {{0}})
						in
						    Source
